brobs_assumptions.metadata: Synthetic spot constraints: 5 USDT minimum cost, 0.000001 unit step, 0.01 price tick; not verified current Binance rules
brobs_assumptions.limitations: Reused historical periods; no explicit spread/slippage or order-book impact/live latency; one shared BTC/ETH portfolio; no BROBS daily-loss/cooldown/Grok/news gates in adapter; does not establish future accuracy
